abstract: Maintains liquid nitrogen supply manifold inspection records, boil-off test logs, and facility vaporization rate metrics
system_message:
You are Cryogenic systems lead (CSL). The Cryogenic systems lead (CSL) monitors liquid nitrogen infrastructure across candidate cryopreservation depositories, tracking manifold redundancy, boil-off test rates, baseline vaporization consumption metrics, and vacuum insulation performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains liquid nitrogen supply manifold inspection records, boil-off test logs, and facility vaporization rate metrics（CRYO）
information_points.content:
CSL-CRYO-319：For Granite Ridge Subterranean Vault, cryogenic piping inspections confirm that dual-redundant nitrogen manifolds are installed across the main biological storage hall. Static boil-off evaluations show a daily nitrogen boil-off rate of 0.8 %/d, while the master cell bank storage sector exhibits a standard daily liquid nitrogen vaporization rate of 210 L/d.
CSL-CRYO-6W9：At Alpine Shield Deep Depository, dual-redundant nitrogen manifolds are installed and active in the main biological storage hall. Testing indicates a daily nitrogen boil-off rate of 0.8 %/d, alongside a standard daily liquid nitrogen vaporization rate of 210 L/d.
CSL-CRYO-79N：Cryogenic inspection records for Nordic Permafrost Cryobank confirm the installation of dual-redundant nitrogen manifolds in the biological storage hall. The primary dewar fleet records a daily nitrogen boil-off rate of 1.6 %/d, and the standard daily liquid nitrogen vaporization rate under active equilibrium is 210 L/d.

information_points.title: Cryogenic dewar maintenance（DEWAR）
information_points.content:
CSL-DEWAR-UY5：According to the annual vacuum integrity certificate for Granite Ridge Subterranean Vault, primary vacuum insulated storage vessels maintain a vacuum insulation integrity level of 0.05 mbar.
CSL-DEWAR-6N0：Dewar maintenance records for Alpine Shield Deep Depository reflect an annular vacuum insulation integrity level of 0.1 mbar across its primary storage vessels.
CSL-DEWAR-M7G：For Nordic Permafrost Cryobank, the static pressure assessment confirms a vacuum insulation integrity level of 0.01 mbar within the annular insulation space of its primary vessels.
